items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: A kid named Demerrill. And, oh, I don't know, he used to kind of bug me a little, you know?

ctx.x: Yeah, some kid was playing the trumpet on New Orleans. A kid named Demerrill. And, oh, I don't know, he used to kind of bug me a little, you know? Yeah. The thing about trumpet, I couldn't play trumpet. I said, well, in a month's time I'll play it better than you.
You did at that, huh? Yeah, I was in the band in a month's time. Did you have lessons when you took up the banjo? How old were you, though?
